notes: Owned. SMBIOS on this PC, 2026-09-30: MSI PRO Z690-A DDR4, board code MS-7D25, BIOS 1.30 (the manual also covers the WIFI variant; this is the non-WIFI board). Chipset Intel Z690 (the schema has no chipset field). pcie_x16_slots lists the three x16-size slots in the manual's order: PCI_E1 is the CPU slot (PCIe 5.0 x16, the one the checker uses for the GPU), PCI_E3 and PCI_E4 come from the chipset (PCIe 3.0 x4 and x1); the fourth slot, PCI_E2, is x1 and not listed. slot_index is the 0-based bracket position from the top of an ATX case (0 = first bracket under the I/O panel), the reading the checker's expansion_slots - slot_index implies. It is derived, not printed anywhere: in the manual's board diagram (p.12) the slots sit at 0, 2, 3 and 5 pitches of 20.32 mm from PCI_E1, and PCI_E4 is 0.79 in above the board's bottom edge, where ATX 2.01 Fig. 3 puts the lowest slot, so PCI_E1 is bracket 2 (index 1), PCI_E3 index 4, PCI_E4 index 6. max_ram_gb is 4 slots x 32 GB. JEDEC/POR memory speeds stop at DDR4-3200; anything faster, such as the 3600 kits fitted here, is an XMP overclock. dimensions_mm l x w is the ATX 12 in x 9.6 in outline from the spec sheet; no source gives a board height.
